name: Maruzen Co., Ltd.
summary: Maruzen Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of commercial kitchen equipment in Japan. It offers fryers, steam convection ovens, dishwashers, gas ranges/ gas table stove, noodle boiler, rice washer/rice cooker, small bakery equipment, Gyoza cooker, gas burner, and other products. The company also engages in manufacturing, purchasing, and sales of large bread making machinery. Additionally, it is involved in the leasing of building. Maruzen Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
